g.text: Derivative's own MCP server, launched Sept–Oct 2026 — included
because it changes the landscape the community servers operate in.
A single .tox MCP server running inside TD on TD's bundled Python
(no separate process/bridge): 26 tools to list/inspect operators,
read/set parameters, read DATs, profile cook times, sample
CHOP/TOP/SOP/POP/DAT values, render an operator's output to an
image for the agent, and create/wire/edit operators — plus
get_help/get_docs serving the installed build's own docum
